key_findings: Clips: searchVideoWithUTC {playback:{search_video_with_utc:{channel:0,start_time,end_time (UTC s),start_index:0,end_index:99,id|player_id}}} -> search_video_results[{..:{startTime,endTime,vedio_type}}], to_be_continued paging; legacy searchVideoOfDay/search_video_utility with date

Events: searchDetectionList/search_detection_list (start_time,end_time,start_index,end_index) -> items with alarm_type; PlayBackEventType codes 1 timing,2 motion,4 linecross,5 intrusion,6 person,7 baby cry,8 vehicle,9 pet,...36 CO

Playback on POST /stream: {type:'request',seq,params:{method:'get',playback:{client_id,channels:[0],scale:'1/1',start_time:'<s>',end_time,event_type:[..],filter}}} -> result.session_id; controls do play/pause/stop('playback')
Download: {method:'get',download:{client_id,channels:[0],media_type:0,start_time,end_time,event_type,download_type:'normal'}}; finished via notification stream_status=finished; stop 'download'
Media parts video/mp2t with X-Data-PTS, X-If-IFrame, X-Data-Sequence, X-If-Encrypt; ack every 25 parts with X-Data-Received + stream_sequence notification
TS PMT types: 0x1B H264, 0x24 H265, 0x90 PCMA, 0x91 PCMU, 0x0F AAC, 0x0B Opus; app remuxes to MP4 with MediaMuxer, audio to AAC

RTSP/ONVIF: camera account via get/change/verify/deleteThirdAccount (user_management); get/set Rtsp/OnvifSecurityConfig (security_config); setThirdPartyCompatibility {local_ctrl:{third_party_setting:{enabled}}}; no plain RTSP/ONVIF on/off toggle in app
unresolved: media port: No hard-coded 8800 in Java; port comes from device record (TDP http_port). Confirm against a live camera.
search_video_results map key names: Response is List<Map<String,Item>>; key naming (search_video_results_1 ...) taken from public pytapo, not visible in APK.
vedio_type vs alarm_type semantics: Assumed both use PlayBackEventType codes; mapping code for the record list was not traced end to end.

Stream key derivation secret: Which password form (plain cloud password / MD5 / SHA256 / camera account) feeds the AES key is determined in the live-stream path (o81.c.d / o81.c.f, GenKey); covered by the live-stream spec.
Record plan day-string format: RecordPlanInfo monday..sunday string encoding not decoded.

REA coverage: REA Android class/method inspection needs REA_JADX_MCP_JAR; Ghidra backend on Windows only accepts PE, so native ELF libs could not be decompiled via REA. All APK facts come from the JADX tree.
ONVIF events/discovery: No ONVIF client code in APK; PullPoint/WS-Discovery facts are external and must be validated on the device.
